name: La Jaraba

known.via: English Wikipedia "La Jaraba" (redirects to "La Jaraba (Vino de Pago)") (a wine place on Wikidata)

terms: A wine from a pago, a named rural site with its own soil and microclimate. All its grapes must grow there.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

blurb.text: A Vino de Pago estate in El Provencio. A Vino de Pago applies to a single estate. Allowed grapes include Cabernet Sauvignon, Graciano, Merlot, Tempranillo and Sauvignon Blanc.
